dc:title: Word index of North-Eastern Romani in 18th–19th-century sources
dc:description: CLDF version of the word index (Словоуказатель) in K. A. Kozhanov, Цыганский язык в источниках XVIII–XIX вв. (из архивов России и Литвы), St Petersburg 2025. Headwords are generalised North-Eastern Romani forms; each attestation gives the form as written in the source, a Latin transliteration, and the source citation.
dc:creator: Kirill Kozhanov
dc:bibliographicCitation: Kozhanov, Kirill. 2025. Цыганский язык в источниках XVIII–XIX вв. (из архивов России и Литвы). St Petersburg: Mamatov.

tables.dc:description: Headwords of the index. Derived forms (уменьш., прич., нар., сравн., порядк., деепр., отр.) and prefixed verbs are separate rows linked to their main entry via Main_Entry_ID.

columns.name: Headword
columns.dc:description: Generalised North-Eastern Romani form as in the book; | separates stem and ending

columns.name: Paradigm
columns.dc:description: Further forms given with the headword: imperative and past for verbs, plural or feminine/plural endings for nominals

columns.name: Part_Of_Speech
columns.dc:description: Grammatical labels as in the book (Russian abbreviations)

columns.name: Main_Entry_ID
columns.dc:description: For derived forms and prefixed verbs: the entry they are listed under

columns.name: Subentry_Type
columns.dc:description: Label of a derived form (уменьш., прич., нар. …) or 'prefix'

columns.name: Meaning
columns.dc:description: Meaning in Russian as in the book

columns.name: Meaning_Latin
columns.dc:description: Scholarly transliteration of Meaning

columns.name: Distribution
columns.dc:description: Note on distribution in the North-Eastern dialects (есть в … / нет в …)

columns.name: Derived_From
columns.dc:description: Base of derivation (← …)

columns.name: Composition
columns.dc:description: Composition (= …)

columns.name: Etymology
columns.dc:description: Etymological note (Этим.) in Russian

columns.name: See_Also
columns.dc:description: Headwords referred to with 'см. также'

columns.name: Description
columns.dc:description: Russian, as in the book

tables.dc:description: Every form cited from the sources, in the order of the book, one row per form and source.

columns.name: Form
columns.dc:description: As written in the source (Cyrillic or Latin script, with the source's diacritics)

columns.name: Form_Latin
columns.dc:description: Latin transliteration of Cyrillic forms (see README); Latin-script forms unchanged

columns.name: Source_Abbreviation
columns.dc:description: Citation as printed in the book

columns.name: Editor_Note
columns.dc:description: The author's grammatical labels before the form (мн., пов. 2 ед., субст. ж. …)

columns.name: Source_Annotation
columns.dc:description: Everything the source gives after the form: further inflected forms in brackets, translations in «», + additional meanings

columns.name: Source_Glosses
columns.dc:description: Translations quoted from the source («…»); '+ ' marks an additional meaning

columns.name: Sense_Numbers
columns.dc:description: Sense(s) of the headword this form attests, where the book marks them with (1), (2)

columns.name: Uncertain
columns.dc:description: Morphologically unclear form, marked (?) in the book

columns.name: Same_Form_As_Previous
columns.dc:description: Row repeats the previous form for a further source that adds a meaning or forms (… Григ. 1851, + «овца» Григ. 1852)
